# Up The Keys Tours (concept by Kerblabs)

> Day tours, Key West walking tours and a tiki bar crawl in Key West and the Florida Keys. This is an unaffiliated concept page; facts come from upthekeys.com.

- Address: 6810 Front St, Key West, FL 33040
- Phone: 305-587-5575 (groups of 12 or more on walking tours: 305-928-8961)
- Email: upthekeystour@gmail.com
- Booking: FareHarbor online, or by phone
- Hours: not published

## Tours (prices per their site)
- 4HR Up the Keys Nature Tour: adults $119, children $35, 4 hours, starts in Key West
- Aquarium Encounters Day Tour: adults $159, children $35
- Dolphin Research Center Day Tour: adults $159, children $35
- Marathon to Key West Private Day Tour: $549 for up to 6, plus $35 per additional guest
- Welcome to Key West Walking Tour: $275 for up to 6, plus $35 per additional guest
- Haunted History Walking Tour: $275 for up to 6, plus $35 per additional guest
- Florida Keys Tiki Bar Crawl: $350 for up to 4, plus $35 per additional guest, adults only

## FAQ
- Where? Key West and the Florida Keys, including Marathon to Key West.
- How to book? FareHarbor online, or call 305-587-5575.
